name: MerchantBastion B2B Tax ID Check for WooCommerce
author: bdsmart001

sections.description:
WooCommerce does not check EU VAT numbers by itself. This plugin adds an optional VAT number field to the checkout, checks the number with the European Commission VIES service, and removes VAT only when the number is valid and the order ships to another EU country.

What it does

  • Adds an optional EU VAT number field to the classic checkout and to the block checkout (the block checkout field needs WooCommerce 8.9 or newer). The field appears after you save your own EU VAT number in the settings.
  • The buyer sees the result right below the field, in the classic and the block checkout, for example “VAT number confirmed. VAT is removed from this order.” or the reason VAT stays.
  • Adds VAT back if the shipping address changes to your own country or to a country that does not match the VAT number, or if the VAT number is removed before the order is placed. A number that does not qualify never blocks the order.
  • Saves the VIES check reference and an invoice note in English on the order: for goods, “Exempt intra-Community supply of goods (Article 138(1), Council Directive 2006/112/EC)”; for services (virtual products), the reverse charge note (Article 196).
  • Shows the VAT number and the invoice note on the order screen, the order received page, the My Account order page and the order e-mails.
  • When VIES is down, VAT is charged and the number is checked again every hour. If you turn on “Refund VAT automatically”, the VAT is refunded to the buyer once the number is confirmed; otherwise the order is marked so you can refund it yourself.
  • Adds an optional Australian Business Number (ABN) field for Australian buyers and saves it on the order.
  • Copies VAT numbers and check results from the retired Aelia EU VAT Assistant (your latest 250 orders; the old fields are not changed).

External services

  1. European Commission VIES service: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/rest-api/check-vat-number
    • When: when a buyer enters an EU VAT number at checkout, and again later for orders placed while VIES was down.
    • What is sent: the buyer’s VAT number and your own VAT number.
    • VIES disclaimer and privacy statement: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/#/disclaimer
  2. No other outside service is contacted. Every feature of this plugin is free and works without an account or a license key.

Disclaimer

This plugin checks tax numbers with VIES and keeps a record of each check. It is not an EU tool and it is not tax or legal advice. You stay responsible for deciding when an order is exempt from VAT, including keeping proof that the goods left your country.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zip in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, then activate it.
  2. Open WooCommerce > B2B Tax ID Check and save your own EU VAT number.
  3. Optional: if you used Aelia EU VAT Assistant before, click “Copy VAT numbers from Aelia”.
sections.faq:
Does a wrong VAT number block the order?

No. VAT stays on the order and, in the classic checkout, the buyer sees why.

What happens when VIES is down?

VAT is charged and the order is marked. The number is checked again every hour. If you turn on “Refund VAT automatically” in the settings, the VAT is refunded through your payment method once the number is confirmed. If it is off, or the refund fails, the order shows that the VAT still needs to be refunded.

Is anything locked or paid?

No. Every feature in this plugin is free, with no product or order limits.

Does it work with High-Performance Order Storage and the block checkout?

It declares support for both and reads and writes orders only through the WooCommerce order functions.
sections.changelog:
1.10.0

  • The checkout helper script is now loaded with the standard WordPress functions.
  • All function, option and order data names now use the plugin prefix “mercbtic”.

1.9.0

  • Every feature is now free: the license key field and the plan check were removed.
  • New setting “Refund VAT automatically” (off by default) for orders placed while VIES was not answering.
  • The plugin no longer contacts any service other than VIES.

1.8.1

  • Fix: after an order with a valid VAT number, a later order without a VAT number could keep VAT removed. VAT is now added back, and the order gets a note.
  • Fix: in the block checkout the VAT number was not checked while the buyer typed it. It is now checked, and the result is shown below the field.
  • Fix: the invoice note for goods now names the exempt intra-Community supply (Article 138). Services keep the reverse charge note.
  • The VAT number and invoice note are shown on the order screen, the order received page, My Account and the order e-mails.
  • Orders placed while VIES was down are checked again every hour until VIES answers.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.3.

1.8.0

  • Adds the EU VAT number field to the classic and the block checkout, and an ABN field for Australia.
  • The buyer sees the result of the VAT check. A number that does not qualify no longer blocks the order.
  • Plain texts on the settings page, a warning until your own VAT number is saved, and a short cache for VIES answers.

1.7.0

  • Saves Australian ABNs and US resale certificate details on the order.
